title: Unemployment insurance - federal/state framework
facts: Unemployment insurance is a joint federal-state system; states administer regular unemployment benefits under state law within federal requirements.
Eligibility, weekly benefit amounts, maximum duration, taxable wage bases and filing procedures vary by state.
A claimant generally files with the unemployment insurance program of the state where the work was performed, subject to interstate and multi-state claim rules.
Federal law provides the framework, but a specific eligibility or benefit calculation normally requires current state rules and the worker's employment history.
